title: Pure Yosenju
summary: Pure Yosenju hit-and-run strategy, fielding swift WIND Beast-Warriors and towering Mayosenju Pendulums that swarm the field, bounce opposing threats, and return safely to the hand during the End Phase to avoid destruction. The archetype pairs high-speed chain Normal Summons with oppressive bouncing backrow.

summary.title: Starters
points: Yosenju Kama 1 immediately Normal Summons another Yosenju monster from hand upon Normal Summon, and bounces a face-up card the opponent controls to the hand while you control another Yosenju.
Yosenju Kama 2 Normal Summons another Yosenju upon Normal Summon and can attack the opponent directly for halved battle damage.
Yosenju Kama 3 Normal Summons another Yosenju upon Normal Summon and searches any Yosenju card from your Deck whenever a Yosenju inflicts battle damage.
Yosenju Oroshi Channeling searches a Level 6 or higher Yosenju monster from your Deck while controlling no monsters, or places Yosenju Shinchu L and R directly into your Pendulum Zones.
Yosenju Sabu searches a Yosenju Pendulum Monster from Deck on summon and places Yosenju Whirlwind or Dizzying Winds of Yosen Village from Deck.
Yosenju Izna prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects in response to your Yosenju Normal or Special Summons, and draws 1 card when a Yosenju is summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Kama Chain + Sword Sting
steps: Normal Summon Yosenju Kama 1; activate its effect to immediately Normal Summon Yosenju Kama 2 from hand.
Kama 2 triggers on summon to immediately Normal Summon Yosenju Kama 3 from hand.
Kama 1 bounces a face-up card your opponent controls to the hand.
Attack with all three Kama brothers, triggering Kama 3 to search Mayosenju Daibak (or Yosenju Sabu).
Set Yosenjus' Sword Sting and Yosenjus' Secret Move in your Spell & Trap Zone.
During the End Phase, all three Kama monsters return to your hand, leaving your board clear and your backrow live.

summary.title: Pendulum Scales & Mayosenju Bosses
points: Yosenju Shinchu L (Scale 3) protects your Yosenju monsters from destruction by destroying itself instead.
Yosenju Shinchu R (Scale 5) scales up to Scale 11 while you control another Yosenju in the Pendulum Zone, allowing Pendulum Summons of high-Level Mayosenju bosses.
Mayosenju Hitot (Scale 3) modulates a Yosenju scale to 11, returns a Yosenju card to hand to bounce an opponent's card, and boosts all Yosenjus by 500 ATK whenever a card returns to the hand.
Mayosenju Daibak is a Level 10 Pendulum boss that targets and returns up to 2 cards on the field to the hand upon summon and gains 300 ATK when your card returns to hand.
Yosenju Misak destroys a face-up monster on the field when Pendulum Summoned without damage calculation.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Yosenjus' Sword Sting reveals up to 2 Yosenju monsters with different names in hand to target and return that many face-up cards the opponent controls to the hand.
Yosenjus' Secret Move is an omni-negating Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a Yosenju card and no non-Yosenju monsters.
Yosen Training Grounds accumulates counters on Yosenju summons, removing 1 counter for a 300 ATK boost or 3 counters to search any Yosenju card.
Yosenju Wind Worship returns all Yosenju cards you control to the hand to draw cards until you have 5 in hand.
